review_notes: I read the whole file and searched Mathlib's Topology/Sheaves and CategoryTheory/Sites for overlapping concepts. The `Abelian (TopCat.Sheaf …)` instance is a clear duplicate of an existing Mathlib instance. Two checks turned up no definition-level competitor. `closedIncl` has no Mathlib counterpart; `Opens.map` is only used there for opens. `opensMap_isLocallyFull` has no Opens.map version in Mathlib. `stalkFunctor_map_iso_toSheafify` restates `TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor_map_unit_toSheafify_isIso` in Mathlib/Topology/Sheaves/Sheafify.lean, but that is standalone theorem duplication, which the rubric excludes, so I did not report it. Remaining uncertainty: I did not confirm that `HasSheafify (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) AddCommGrpCat.{u}` is found for every `X : TopCat.{u}`. The target file's existing `inferInstanceAs (Abelian (CategoryTheory.Sheaf _ _))` already needs this, so the Mathlib instance should apply.

findings.excerpt:
instance sheafAbelianAddCommGrp (X : TopCat.{u}) :
    Abelian (TopCat.Sheaf AddCommGrpCat.{u} X) :=
  inferInstanceAs (Abelian (CategoryTheory.Sheaf _ _))
findings.problem: This instance re-declares the `Abelian` structure on `TopCat.Sheaf` for `AddCommGrpCat`. Mathlib already provides it for every abelian `C` with `HasSheafify (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) C`, in `Mathlib/Topology/Sheaves/Abelian.lean`. That instance has the same body, `inferInstanceAs (Abelian (CategoryTheory.Sheaf _ _))`. The file adds a second, differently named instance for the same class on the same type. This risks two non-syntactically-equal `Abelian` instances in downstream code, and the name is a one-off that nothing else in the repo uses. A grep for `sheafAbelianAddCommGrp` finds only this definition. The file does not import `Mathlib.Topology.Sheaves.Abelian`, which is probably why the instance was added.
findings.proposed_change: Delete `sheafAbelianAddCommGrp`. Add `public import Mathlib.Topology.Sheaves.Abelian` if it is not already available transitively. The generic `TopCat.Sheaf.instAbelian…` instance then supplies `Abelian (TopCat.Sheaf AddCommGrpCat.{u} X)`, since `HasSheafify` for `AddCommGrpCat` is found the same way it already is for the `inferInstanceAs` line.
findings.benefit: Only one `Abelian` instance exists for sheaves on a topological space, with no risk of instance diamonds. The file also no longer has a parallel copy of Mathlib API that readers must check is the same.
